description: Submit free-text feedback about the API - a bug, a feature request, a docs gap, a billing question, or anything else. Tied to your key so we can follow up, but not billed and not a support-ticket SLA. Auth required; not billed.

contact_ok.description: Optional, defaults to false. Whether we may follow up with you about this.

endpoint.description: Optional. Which /v1/* endpoint or MCP tool this is about, e.g. "/v1/ticket-lint".

message.description: What you want us to know. Up to 4000 characters.

name: feedback
